source_text: Facit quoque epistolae mentionem, quam a me ait Romam fuisse directam; sed per verba quae posuit, nequivimus quo de scripto loqueretur, agnoscere [n14] . Nam ad Zosimum quondam illius civitatis episcopum super his quaestionibus duas epistolas destinavi; verum eo tempore, quo adhuc libros exorsus non eram.
pass_a_gloss: He also makes mention of a letter which he says was directed by me to Rome; but through the words which he placed we have been unable to recognize about which writing he was speaking. For to Zosimus, formerly bishop of that city, I sent two letters upon these questions; but at that time when I had not yet begun the books.

lemmas.lexica: proper name; Blaise episcopal title in context

pass_b_english: He also mentions a letter which he says I sent to Rome, but from the words he quotes we have been unable to recognize which writing he means (Augustine, On Marriage and Concupiscence 2.2). I did send two letters on these questions to Zosimus, formerly bishop of that city, but that was at a time when I had not yet begun the books.

choices.why: Loaded word in Julian's Latin at 1.18; English follows LS/Blaise range without copying NPNF.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
